title: Wild Justice - Inspired by the ZX Spectrum's The Wild Bunch.
author: Excellent_Crow_3741
selftext:
Wild Justice is heavily inspired by the ZX Spectrum classic *The Wild Bunch*. I set out to build an easy-to-pick-up, highly replayable Western where every run plays out differently.

There is no save function.. when you die, that's it! A run might last 10 minutes or an hour. You can spend your time messing around in the saloon drinking and playing poker, or stay focused on the main objective: tracking down 10 wanted outlaws before your train leaves town. It’s packed with mini-missions, random events, and open-ended choices to capture that genuine 8-bit retro tension in a modern 3D world.

I have just released a huge update for the game which has enhanced the experience considerably. I will be continuously releasing new updates as I am very passionate about this project. If you have any suggestions or criticisms, please let me know.

On a personal note: I’ve hand-coded about 80% of this game, but I’ve also been upfront about using AI tools to assist with roughly 20% of the workflow. I know AI in game dev can be a sensitive topic on Reddit, but to me, it's just another programming tool, no different to "copy & paste" which programmers use endlessly to speed things up.

Please have a look at the game on Steam, or even just Wishlist it.  
I would love to hear your thoughts.
